I can give you an apple custard recipe that is a family favorite.

2 tbs flour

2 tbs unsalted butter

1/2 c light-brown sugar

1/2 tsp cinnamon

1/2 tsp ginger

1/4 tsp nutmeg

1/4 tsp salt

2 tbs cider vinegar

1 c & 1 tsp water, divided

2 & 1 eggs, divided

1 tbs sugar

Pie crust top & bottom

Roll out your bottom crust and fit it to the pan, cut the top crust to fit. Put both crusts in the refrigerator to chill. preheat to 350°f, melt butter over low heat, take off the heat. Whisk in brown sugar, flour, spices, salt, vinegar, and 1 cup water. Lightly beat 2 eggs, and whisk into mixture. Return pan to low heat, and cook, stirring often, until mixture is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, 10 to 12 minutes. Remove from heat, and let cool to room temperature, about 20 minutes, keep stirring. Let filling cool to room temperature. Pour filling into shell, seal and crimp the crusts together. Vent the top crust. Mix 1 egg and 1 tsp water brush the eggwash onto the top, sprinkle the raw sugar on top. Bake for ~ 45 min
